```python
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # Find the full-height divider.
    divider = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h)))

    # Identify the non-background object on either side of the divider.
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    pixels = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    left_side = any(c < divider for _, c, _ in pixels)
    min_c = min(c for _, c, _ in pixels)
    max_c = max(c for _, c, _ in pixels)

    # Slide the object until it is adjacent to the divider.
    shift = divider - 1 - max_c if left_side else divider + 1 - min_c
    for r, c, _ in pixels:
        g[r][c] = bg
    for r, c, color in pixels:
        g[r][c + shift] = color

    # Mark the object's former outer edge with a full-height line.
    edge = min_c if left_side else max_c
    for r in range(h):
        g[r][edge] = 8

    return g
```
